# RcSignalQuality (push)

OSD GetPushSignalQuality - RC/OSD link signal-quality push, sent by the OSD device (sender type 14) at a few Hz.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** dji.go.v4 decompile, DataOsdGetPushSignalQuality.java (dji.pilot's own copy could not be recovered, see awto-dji#16, but this struct is aircraft/OSD-side protocol, not app-specific). byte0 bit7 = direction (set=Up/uplink, clear= Down/downlink); byte0 bits0-6 = aggregate link quality 0-127 (the headline metric - what getDownSignalQuality()/getUpSignalQuality() return). bytes1-2 = per-antenna signed dBm (secondary breakdown - an earlier version of app/packages/duml/lib/src/rc_signal.dart wrongly treated these two bytes as the primary signal and concluded the link was strong while the real quality field was reporting a mediocre ~42% the whole time). Was that file's RcSignalQuality and scripts/re/duml_telemetry.py's `_rc_signal_push`, hand-duplicated in both languages - migrated here to stop that.
